# `scikitplot.levenshtein`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

Levenshtein distance facade with safe optional acceleration.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
```

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it:

python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"
python -c "import scikitplot.levenshtein as m, inspect; print(inspect.signature(m.<name>)); help(m.<name>)"

## Public API

Declared in `scikitplot.levenshtein.__all__`, in that order.

| Name | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BackendInfo` | class | Read-only description of one implementation backend. |
| `Match` | class | One ranked fuzzy-match result with actual backend provenance. |
| `available_backends` | function | Return backend capability records in preferred order. |
| `backend_info` | function | Return capability information for one backend. |
| `closest` | function | Return the closest choice, or ``None`` for an empty iterable. |
| `distance` | function | Return the Levenshtein edit distance between two sequences. |
| `normalized_distance` | function | Return distance normalised to ``[0, 1]`` by maximum sequence length. |
| `normalized_similarity` | function | Return normalised Levenshtein similarity in ``[0, 1]``. |
| `rank` | function | Rank choices from most to least similar to *query*. |
| `similarity` | function | Return ``max(len(a), len(b)) - distance(a, b)``. |

All names with signatures: [references/API.md](references/API.md).
